"; amxGetProducts().forEach((p, i) => { const item = document.createElement("div"); item.style.padding = "10px"; item.style.borderTop = "1px solid currentColor"; const title = document.createElement("strong"); title.textContent = p.name + " — $" + p.price; item.appendChild(title); const desc = document.createElement("p"); desc.textContent = p.description; item.appendChild(desc); if (p.photo) { const img = document.createElement("img"); img.src = p.photo; img.alt = p.name; img.style.maxWidth = "120px"; item.appendChild(img); } const remove = document.createElement("button"); remove.textContent = "Delete"; remove.onclick = () => { const products = amxGetProducts(); products.splice(i, 1); localStorage.setItem("amxProducts", JSON.stringify(products)); amxShowProducts(); }; item.appendChild(remove); area.appendChild(item); }); } amxShowProducts();
